notes: Legacy UC-01 seed code: state-based battle-related deaths (type_of_violence=1). Sum(best) per country-year.
Legacy UC-04 seed code: one-sided violence deaths (type_of_violence=3). Sum(best) per country-year.
Total best-estimate fatalities across all violence types (1+2+3). Sum(best) per country-year.
State-based conflict deaths: sum(best) where type_of_violence==1 per country-year. Canonical enrichment code for UC-01 series.
Non-state (communal/militia) conflict deaths: sum(best) where type_of_violence==2.
One-sided violence deaths: sum(best) where type_of_violence==3. Canonical enrichment code for UC-04 series.
Civilian deaths: sum(deaths_civilians) across all event types per country-year.
Count of one-sided violence GED events per country-year (type_of_violence==3).
Count of non-state conflict GED events per country-year (type_of_violence==2).
Geographic spread of conflict: nunique(adm_1) per country-year across all violence types. adm_1 strings lowercased+stripped before dedup.
One-sided violence deaths where perpetrator is a government actor. Identified by is_government_actor==1. gwno_location may be semicolon-separated; attribute to each. GW->ISO crosswalk required.
Binary: 1 if government-perpetrated one-sided violence deaths > 0 in country-year, else 0.
Count of distinct one-sided violence actor_ids per country-year. gwno_location may be semicolon-separated. GW->ISO crosswalk required.
Binary: 1 if any active conflict in country-year reached intensity_level==2 (war threshold, >=1000 deaths). gwno_loc is semicolon-separated GW codes. GW->ISO crosswalk required.
Count of distinct active state-based conflict_ids per country-year. gwno_loc is semicolon-separated GW codes. GW->ISO crosswalk required.

Binary: 1 if new intrastate state-based conflict onset in country-year. Uses ucdp-intrastate-country-onset-251.csv, field 'newconf' (new conflict indicator). GW->ISO crosswalk via gwno_a. Fallback candidates: onset1, onset2.

derivation: organizedviolencecy: for each (country, year), value = year - max(year' <= year where any_active==1); 0 if active
notes: Years elapsed since last year with sb_exist OR ns_exist OR os_exist == 1. 0 if currently active. NaN if no prior conflict in dataset. Dataset v26.1 uses name-based 'country' column (no gwno_loc); canonical mapping via UCDP_NAME_OVERRIDES + alias map.

Binary: 1 if any internationalized-intrastate conflict (ACD type_of_conflict==4) was active in country-year. type_of_conflict==4 = conflict with external state involvement on government side. gwno_loc semicolon-separated; GW->ISO crosswalk required. Shares ACD bulk (ucdp-prio-acd-261-csv.zip) with UCDP_SB_INTENSITY_WAR.

Binary: 1 if any active ACD conflict in country-year had incompatibility==2 (territorial control dispute). Distinct from incompatibility==1 (government control) and ==3 (both). gwno_loc semicolon-separated; GW->ISO crosswalk required. Shares ACD bulk with UCDP_SB_INTENSITY_WAR.

repair_reason: UCDP peace-agreement bulk CSV is not openly downloadable (all candidate URLs return HTTP 404 as of 2026-06-27). Best available de-escalation proxy in UCDP open data is ACD ep_end==1, which marks the year a conflict episode officially terminated.
notes: Binary: 1 if any state-based conflict episode terminated (ep_end==1) in country-year. ep_end is UCDP/PRIO ACD field set to 1 in the final active year of an episode. Covers 104 countries 1946-2025. gwno_loc semicolon-separated; GW->ISO crosswalk required. Shares ACD bulk with UCDP_SB_INTENSITY_WAR.

repair_reason: GED has no 'protest' tag or category field. type_of_violence has values 1 (state-based), 2 (non-state / communal), 3 (one-sided). No protest-specific filter is possible. Combined tov in {2,3} event count is the best available UCDP unrest/non-governmental-violence proxy: it captures communal clashes and one-sided attacks against civilians, the two GED categories closest to political unrest fatalities. NOT a duplicate of existing specs: UCDP_GED_NS_EVENTS=tov=2 only, UCDP_GED_OS_EVENTS=tov=3 only; this combined count is a distinct feature.
notes: Count of GED conflict events per country-year where type_of_violence in {2=non-state, 3=one-sided}. Covers 107 countries 1989-2024. Country mapped via name string + UCDP_NAME_OVERRIDES. Shares GED bulk with all other UCDP_GED_* indicators.
